root.label: Chino Valley student pronoun notification policy litigation

events.label: Chino Valley student pronoun notification policy litigation

slots.name: policy date
slots.sentence: As Chino Valley Board President, Shaw supported a 2023 policy that would have required employees to notify parents if a student asked to go by a name or pronoun different from official school records or show interest in a sex-segregated program.

slots.name: policy status
slots.sentence: The school district has been blocked from imposing the policy as the case moves to the Supreme Court.
